name: Shadow Fruit
description: A cursed shadow power that commands bats, drains life and bends through darkness.

abilities.name: Blood Swarm
abilities.description: Summon ten shadow bats that orbit the player, damage nearby enemies and restore a small amount of health.

abilities.name: Blood Drain
abilities.description: Damage the nearest enemy and pull crimson energy back to heal the player.

abilities.name: Crimson Burst
abilities.description: Release a close-range shadow explosion. Each enemy hit restores a little health.

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.description: Blink forward through a cloud of dark smoke and bats.
